context: Wilde to Frank Harris, Tuesday [18 September 1900], Paris. A note arranging a meeting, two days before the quarrel about the play that the next letter settles.
quote:
Hotel d’Alsace, Rue des Beaux-Arts. _Tuesday_.

My dear Frank, It will be a great delight to see you — but do telegraph beforehand: if you only send a wire from Calais, I may miss it.

For the rest of your letter many, many thanks.

Ever Oscar
original_provenance: Read at HRC 2676, image 36 - one sheet of Grand Cafe, 14 Boulevard des Capucines paper, sides 1 (left) and 2 (right), the whole letter. Emphasis: one underline, the dateline '_Tuesday_'; the volume keeps the word and drops the mark. Nothing else is underlined. Cancellation: the printed Grand Cafe letterhead is struck through with a single long diagonal stroke in his ink, and 'Hotel d'Alsace' written under it. Another hand: 'Recd. 19th Sept. 1900.' across the head of side 1, not Wilde's. The volume reports this in a footnote and expands it to 'Received 19 September 1900'; the sheet has the abbreviations.
